faq.q: Which is bigger: Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94?
faq.a: The Ferretti 94 is larger at 29 metres, compared to the Mangusta 80 at 24 metres. The extra 5 metres translates to more deck space, a larger saloon, and additional cabins, making the Ferretti 94 more suitable for overnight charters or larger groups wanting extra room.

faq.q: How many guests can each yacht take?

faq.q: What is the price difference between the two?

faq.q: Does the Mangusta 80 include a jet ski?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 charter (both white and grey variants) includes a jet ski at no extra cost for the minimum 4-hour booking. This makes it a great choice for guests who want water sports as part of their day. The Ferretti 94 does not include a jet ski by default, but one can be arranged.

faq.q: Which yacht is better for a party in Marbella?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 is better suited for parties thanks to its open-plan layout, large sun pads, and sporty design. The Ferretti 94 offers a more refined, luxury experience with formal dining and lounges, better for corporate events or elegant celebrations.

faq.q: Which yacht departs from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Both the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 depart from Puerto Banús, the main marina in Marbella. This gives you direct access to the Costa del Sol coastline, including stops at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or Estepona.

faq.q: Can I charter the Ferretti 94 for a half day?
faq.a: Yes, the Ferretti 94 can be chartered for half-day trips, but pricing is customised. Contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. The Mangusta 80 has a minimum of 4 hours at the fixed rate.

faq.q: Which yacht is better for families with children?
faq.a: The Ferretti 94 is better for families due to its larger, more stable platform and multiple interior spaces where kids can retreat from the sun. The Mangusta 80 is more open and better for active families who want water sports and a lively atmosphere.

data.body_html:
When planning a yacht charter in Marbella, two standout options are the Mangusta 80 and the Ferretti 94. Both depart from Puerto Banús, accommodate up to 12 guests, and come with a full crew and inclusive amenities. However, they differ significantly in size, style, and price. This comparison breaks down the key differences to help you decide which yacht fits your Marbella day charter best.

Mangusta 80 vs Ferretti 94: Size and Space

The most obvious difference is length. The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres, while the Ferretti 94 stretches to 29 metres. That extra 5 metres on the Ferretti 94 provides noticeably more deck space, a larger saloon, and additional cabins. If your group values spacious interiors and separate lounging areas, the Ferretti 94 is the better choice. The Mangusta 80, while still generous, has a more compact, sporty layout that encourages mingling and outdoor living.

Capacity and Guest Experience

Both yachts are licensed for 12 guests, but the experience differs. The Mangusta 80 is designed for socialising—its open deck plan and large sun pads create a party atmosphere. The Ferretti 94 offers more privacy and luxury, with multiple zones: a formal dining area, a flybridge lounge, and a spacious foredeck. For a lively day with music and water sports, choose the Mangusta 80. For a refined, spacious cruise with elegant dining, the Ferretti 94 is superior.

Pricing and Inclusions

The Mangusta 80 has a fixed rate: €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. The Ferretti 94 does not have published hourly rates—pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Both include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. The Ferretti 94 will cost significantly more, reflecting its larger size and higher level of luxury.

Best Uses: Party vs Luxury

The Mangusta 80 is ideal for groups who want a fun, active day: swimming, jet skiing, and sunbathing. Its sporty lines and open layout suit bachelor parties, birthday celebrations, or a lively family outing. The Ferretti 94 is better for corporate charters, milestone anniversaries, or anyone seeking a premium, quiet escape. Its flybridge offers shaded seating, and the interior is air-conditioned for hot Marbella afternoons.

Destinations and Itineraries

Both yachts depart from Puerto Banús, giving you access to the best Costa del Sol spots. Popular routes include cruising west to Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, or east towards Cabopino and Estepona. The Ferretti 94’s greater range and comfort make longer trips to Sotogrande or even Gibraltar more feasible. The Mangusta 80 is perfect for a half-day blast along the Golden Mile with a swim stop.

Which Yacht Should You Choose?

If your priority is value, water sports, and a party vibe, the Mangusta 80 is unbeatable. If you want maximum space, luxury, and a quieter, more exclusive experience, the Ferretti 94 is the way to go. Both offer exceptional service from Puerto Banús, but your choice ultimately depends on budget and the type of day you envision. For more options, explore our full fleet of yachts in Marbella.

The Ferretti 94 is larger at 29 metres, compared to the Mangusta 80 at 24 metres. The extra 5 metres translates to more deck space, a larger saloon, and additional cabins, making the Ferretti 94 more suitable for overnight charters or larger groups wanting extra room.

How many guests can each yacht take?

Both yachts accommodate up to 12 guests for day charters. The Mangusta 80 is ideal for a lively party vibe, while the Ferretti 94 offers more elbow room and separate lounging areas, which can feel less crowded even at full capacity.

What is the price difference between the two?

The Mangusta 80 has a fixed rate from €4,719 for 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. The Ferretti 94 does not have published hourly rates; pricing is on request via WhatsApp, as it is a premium, larger vessel. Expect the Ferretti 94 to be significantly more expensive.

Does the Mangusta 80 include a jet ski?

Yes, the Mangusta 80 charter (both white and grey variants) includes a jet ski at no extra cost for the minimum 4-hour booking. This makes it a great choice for guests who want water sports as part of their day. The Ferretti 94 does not include a jet ski by default, but one can be arranged.

Which yacht is better for a party in Marbella?

The Mangusta 80 is better suited for parties thanks to its open-plan layout, large sun pads, and sporty design. The Ferretti 94 offers a more refined, luxury experience with formal dining and lounges, better for corporate events or elegant celebrations.

Which yacht departs from Puerto Banús?

Both the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 depart from Puerto Banús, the main marina in Marbella. This gives you direct access to the Costa del Sol coastline, including stops at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, or Estepona.

Can I charter the Ferretti 94 for a half day?

Yes, the Ferretti 94 can be chartered for half-day trips, but pricing is customised. Contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. The Mangusta 80 has a minimum of 4 hours at the fixed rate.

Which yacht is better for families with children?

The Ferretti 94 is better for families due to its larger, more stable platform and multiple interior spaces where kids can retreat from the sun. The Mangusta 80 is more open and better for active families who want water sports and a lively atmosphere.
